# IT Asset & Support Ticket Log — Aurora Robotics

## Open Support Tickets

Ticket INC-2024-0091 was opened on February 14, 2024 after three field technicians reported that Falcon Drone v2 units failed to complete OTA firmware updates while connected to CloudScale-hosted infrastructure. The ticket was escalated to Severity 1 and resolved in 4 hours 12 minutes, within the internal MTTR (Mean Time To Recovery) target of 6 hours.

## Hardware Returns

RMA-2024-0771 covers the return of 12 Falcon Drone v2 units from the Denver regional distributor due to a defective LIDAR sensor batch traced to supplier lot ASSET-FL2-0447. Replacement units were shipped under purchase order PO-88123.

## Compliance

Aurora Robotics' hosting infrastructure, provided by CloudScale Hosting Inc., completed its SOC 2 Type II audit in March 2024 with zero material findings. The audit report is filed internally under reference AUD-SOC2-2024-03.
